about_the_game:
Enter the life of Joe and make decisions that affect the story in this turn-based RPG which will have you pondering your own morality. You are thrown into a conspiracy involving the Necronomicon and murderous intentions with Satanic hopes. Get lost in the craziness and do your best to be good, or don't. 

Features:

Turn-Based Combat - Challenge yourself with quick combat in an active time battle system which will keep you on your toes.

Saving - Save your progress and return later. 

No Grinding - All enemies are challenging and capable of killing you. You will not fight the same enemy a thousand times.

Voice Acting - Nearly every line is voice acted and will draw you into the world.

Compelling Story - Play as the bad guy and pick up the pieces of a troubled life.

Multiple Choices - Choose how you respond in most dialogue events. These choices will affect outcomes in the Gameworld.

Multiple Endings - Play it again and figure out how not to be evil.

Good Length - At 3 to 5 hours, Human Sacrifice has good replay-ability without overstaying its welcome.

Mini-Games

Can you be good when you were programmed to be evil?

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains violence, nudity, suicide, and other mature themes. Discretion is advised.
